<!-- pr-reviewer: d0fe169a159a14dc5a5973a6c9af332ad70a6cc1 -->
Review at head d0fe169a1. Read, not built: the PR is from a fork, so its code does not run on the maintainer's runners, and no local build slot was free. The author reports the quick gate (251 steps) and the reached heavy gate (196 steps) green on macOS arm64 at this head, and the test red on plain main before it.

The change reads well:
- `default_machine_problems`: the refusal now carries the operations too - `machine of Setup2 for Face2: <file error>`. I checked the `ops` collection: it keeps only operations whose setup is in `bare`, so a mounted operation with its own machine (Face1) cannot appear. The empty-ops early return keeps the old "nothing to post" behaviour.
- No other test pins the old message shape; the #2319 per-mount test still passes because the setup names are unchanged in the string.
- The regression now pins the setup name, the operation name, and the Face1 exclusion. The decision file `docs/decisions/3089-default-machine-operation.md` records why the fix stays in the preflight.
- Sizes obey the rule. No process files, no snapshot PNGs. Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #3089`.

Clean. Labels: merge-ready, and P1 with its issue (per the review law, the PR carries the P label of the issue it fixes). Note for the merge batch: P1 refusal diagnostic - nothing is posted either way; a safety-tier second read before the merge fits the floor rule.
